Definition: to place (in a very wide application)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to put, set; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to put, lay (hand upon); 1a2) to set, station, appoint, fix, set mind to; 1a3) to constitute, make (one something), make like, perform; 1a4) to take one's stand; 1a5) to lay waste; 1b) (Hophal) to be imposed, be set upon
